tasks.description: Enforce rate limits using a token-bucket algorithm scoped to each API key. This will ensure that each key gets an independent allowance. The algorithm should be designed to handle a high volume of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API key, when the token bucket is full, then the request is allowed
Given an API key, when the token bucket is empty, then the request is rejected with a 429 status

tasks.description: Make the bucket capacity and refill rate configurable via application configuration. This will allow for easy adjustment of the rate limits without requiring code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration file, when the bucket capacity is updated, then the new capacity is used
Given a configuration file, when the refill rate is updated, then the new rate is used

tasks.description: Store rate-limit counters/state in Redis to enforce limits consistently across all server instances. This will ensure that the rate limits are applied uniformly across all instances.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Redis instance, when a request is made, then the counter is updated
Given a Redis instance, when the counter is updated, then the new value is stored

tasks.description: Reject requests that exceed the rate limit with an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status. This will inform the client that the request has been rejected due to excessive usage.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API key, when the rate limit is exceeded, then a 429 status is returned

tasks.description: Include a Retry-After header on 429 responses indicating how long the client should wait before retrying. This will help the client to understand when it can retry the request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 429 response, when the Retry-After header is present, then the header contains a valid retry time

tasks.description: Integrate the rate-limiting middleware with the API routes to apply the rate limits uniformly to all authenticated API traffic. This will ensure that the rate limits are enforced consistently across all routes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API route, when a request is made, then the rate limit is applied
Given an API route, when the rate limit is exceeded, then a 429 status is returned

tasks.description: Write unit tests to verify the correctness of the rate-limiting middleware. This will ensure that the middleware is working as expected and catch any regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when the tests are run, then all tests pass
